Eastern Court Magistrate Kestrel Lam Tsz-hong on Tuesday found 59-year-old Patrick Lam Win-hon not guilty of one count of loitering causing concern, despite acknowledging that the defendant had loitered at one of Causeway Bay’s leading girls’ schools on July... item.title: AI smart glasses force South Korea to rewrite its exam rules
item.description: South Korea is preparing to overhaul the rules governing technical qualification exams after five candidates were caught using AI-powered smart glasses to cheat in just over two months. The five cases, reported between May and June, were disclosed in data submitted to the Human Resources Development Service of Korea by opposition politician Kim So-hee, according to a report by The Korea Herald on Monday. In two of the cases – in Gwangju and Daegu – the candidates were caught because examiners... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Government lays out housing plans but Burnham backtracks on social renting pledge – UK politics live
item.description: £10bn for housing with 60% social renting is at odds with PM’s previous call for programme to be spent entirely on social homes Good morning and welcome to the UK politics live blog. The government has set out its plans to spend an initial £10bn on a mix of subsidised housing in England, with a target of 60% being social renting. There’s £39bn allocated over a 10-year period … I’m saying that should be dedicated to council homes. Let’s not be coy any more … I’m saying council homes because control matters. Andy Burnham has said he plans to travel to the US next month to join European leaders… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Haití: "Noche de terror" en Kenscoff por ataque de bandas que deja más de 40 muertos, entre ellos desplazados
item.description: Una incursión nocturna de bandas armadas en Kenscoff, una localidad situada en las alturas sobre Puerto Príncipe, dejó más de 40 muertos y decenas de heridos, además de varios desaparecidos, según autoridades haitianas y Naciones Unidas. El ataque alcanzó un campamento de desplazados instalado en una iglesia y volvió a evidenciar el impacto de la violencia de las bandas en Haití, donde cerca de 1,5 millones de personas han sido desplazadas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
